name: Signature Casting

pose: She stands mid-cast, commanding and composed, her gaze toward the camera. Adjust the pose only: weight shifted, chin lifted, her free hand raised and open as she channels.
notes: The first full 'scene' assembly -- hero + armor/weapon preserved from a prior stage (not regenerated here) + effects + background + pose tweak, grounded in prompts/_archive/Drakness/final/Drakness_FireRed_SD-001_Final.txt.
